message.content:
A typical medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **25 – 30 calories**.  
If you’re looking at it per 100 g, the average is about **22 calories**.  

These values can vary slightly depending on the variety and ripeness, but they’re a good rule of thumb for most fresh tomatoes.
